newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Fotex rallies in early trading.
newsitem.headline: Fotex rallies in early trading.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian retail chain Fotex Rt rallied 13 percent in early trading on Monday but traders could not give any explanation for the rise saying they were unaware of any new developments in the group.
Fotex shares opened at 137 forints, below Friday's close of 138 forints and rallied to 157 forints in matter of minutes. After a short dip it rose further to 162 forints at 1101 GMT.
However, in a statement in the official bourse gazette, Fotex said today that subscription period for the second tranche of Fotex's Gemini convertible bonds opened on March 1.
Fotex shareholders in November decided that the company should issue convertible bonds privately worth $20 million in four equal tranches from November 1996 to April 1998.
